rung_purposes.purpose: R1: Detect conveyor motor overload trip (X13 open) and set alarm M191.
R2: Reset ST10 fault latch M190 when reset pushbutton X1 is pressed.
R3: Evaluate common fault M199 from fault latch M190, motor overload M191, or E-stop loss.
R4: Energize conveyor motor contactor Y10 when auto mode is selected and no fault is active.
R5: Indicate pallet in position (M100) from pallet stop photo-eye X10.
R6: Latch stopper release solenoid Y11 on rising edge of line controller request X14.
R7: Run 2.0 s pulse timer T11 while stopper release solenoid Y11 is active.
R8: Unlatch stopper release solenoid Y11 once timer T11 completes.
